headline: Tropical Storm Isaias set to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026
summary: After an unusually quiet Atlantic hurricane season, Tropical Storm Isaias is forecast to become the basin's first hurricane of 2026, bringing life-threatening rain and storm surge to the Gulf Coast.
